opening_intro.text:
Hello, I'm Erin.

I am a mindfulness practitioner and advocate of mindfulness as a way of life. 

Most of my work in mindful urban living is embodied in Niàn Life, a global community inspired by the simple philosophy and practice of Niàn - A Reminder to Live Better. Our content and collective currently reside at www.nianlife.com on Substack.

I co-initiated The Big Sit (www.thebigsit.co) - a social meditation movement that lends accessibility to mindfulness practice in the city and reimagines the relationship between people and place.

I'm currently based in Singapore and work with individuals, communities, and organisations in delivering mindfulness-based training, curriculum design, and coaching. 

If you're curious about how mindfulness came to be my lifework, I invite you to visit my personal portfolio website at www.mindfulmoments.sg   

I'm also on Insight Timer as a teacher: https://insighttimer.com/erinmindfulmoments

Specialties: Mindfulness, Meditation, Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction, Mental Health and Wellness, Group Facilitation, Speaking, Coaching, Workshops, Lifelong Learning, Writing, Singing
